name: Stephen Kercel
abstract_title: What entanglement implies and what it does not
abstract: Three events need to be viewed with respect to their connection with each other. In 1935, EPR proposed that there was something that quantum mechanics could not do. They observed that the solutions to Schrodinger's equation for two-component processes included several solutions that could not be factored into sub-processes in which the process could be described as the cumulative interaction of the sub-processes.
